open_gaps.gap: R5c regresses at honestly matched total NFE (+9.2% to +14.6% FID). Root cause: apply_restart_distribution builds blend = m*x1_hat + (1-m)*x0, which is exactly the linear-FM path state at t = m, but solve_ode hard-coded the interval [0,1]. So every restart re-traversed the full path from a state that is not a valid t=0 state. Invariant violated: beta=0 ('keep everything') is NOT a no-op (measured max|delta| = 1.0137, 24.9% relative drift on a [-1,1] signal).
open_gaps.acceptance: (1) solve_ode honours t0/t1 from ODEConditionDelta with defaults 0/1 so legacy calls stay byte-identical. (2) --restart-t0-mode {zero,memory} and --nfe-allocation {scheduler,uniform,proportional}. (3) beta=0 under memory mode is an exact no-op (unit test). (4) D.4 30/30. (5) N=200 mechanism screen done (5 mechanisms, 25 configs, 3 genuine draws) and recorded in the audit; N=1000 confirmation is now folded into GAP-57, where the regime ladder is re-measured at equal total NFE so a confirmation is not spent on a cell the mechanism cannot win.
open_gaps.result: Root cause confirmed and fixed: solve_ode ignored t0/t1, so a restart whose blend is the path state at t=m was re-integrated over the full [0,1] with a 1/(1-m) times too large step. beta=0 was not a no-op (max|delta|=1.0137, 24.9% relative drift). Second defect: the prior is keyed only on (batch_id, sample_id) and solve_ode discards its seed, so the Wave 280 '3-seed' R5c runs are three byte-identical copies. After the fix (t0=memory + equal total NFE + proportional allocation) the regression roughly halves but does not vanish: legacy +10.8..+20.9% -> +6.7..+9.7% at NFE=50 (three genuine prior draws, 18/18 cells positive, sign test p~3.8e-06). 25 configurations across five sampler-side mechanisms (beta budget, restart start time, NFE allocation, round count, total budget) never beat the baseline anywhere in NFE in [3,50]. FID decomposition: the sampler moves ~1 unit of an ~11-unit model-versus-reference gap, and the baseline reaches its FID floor by ~15 NFE. The historical -28.43% was measured on the smoke checkpoint. Conclusion: the sampler-side lever is exhausted on the production checkpoint; the governing variable is the model's own residual error (GAP-35), which now has to be re-tested under equal total NFE (GAP-57).

open_gaps.gap: GAP-35 established that the restart gain is monotone in the model's optimisation budget (78-93 steps -> -25..-28%; 937+ steps -> +3..+10%), i.e. the mechanism corrects residual velocity-field error. But every framework arm in that table was run at the legacy per-round cap (~2x the baseline's NFE; GAP-44: R5c arms 25/48/25 vs baseline 50), so the magnitude of every win is confounded with compute. GAP-55 and GAP-56 showed that once total NFE is matched the production checkpoint regresses. Whether the GAP-35 ladder survives equal total NFE is unknown, and it decides whether R5c is a validated mechanism with a documented boundary or a compute artefact.

open_gaps.result: Ladder survives equal total NFE (50 both sides) at N=1000; magnitudes are ~42% of the legacy values. N=1000, 3 genuine prior draws (42/43/44), 4 checkpoints, record-level paired bootstrap B=2000 with a bias-corrected interval. w16e1_5k (baseline 24.488+-0.108): cosine -9.37% (3/3 draws, CI excludes 0, 100% of replicates favour the framework); codim +0.17% and evidence +0.25% are ties. w16e1_10k (16.959+-0.084): cosine +2.81%, codim +10.69%, evidence +7.49% -- all significant regressions. w16e1_60k (11.380+-0.029): +15.59 / +19.43 / +15.87. production (9.989+-0.022): +9.52 / +12.87 / +10.34. Census 3 wins / 27 losses / 6 ties over 36 cells. Delta% on baseline FID: slope -1.177 %/FID, R2 0.855, zero crossing at FID 22.48. Compute confound: 13.15 pp of the 22.52 pp legacy headline win at w16e1_5k (58%); legacy -25.39% is a chunk-mean estimator and its 3 'seeds' are one draw with three chunk partitions. SECOND DEFECT FOUND: the FID estimator is badly biased at small n -- calibration with a true FID of 0 gives 23.98 at n=200 and 4.73 at n=1000; for a paired delta whose true value is 11.52 the estimate is 18.99 at n=200 and 12.99 at n=1000. N=200 effect sizes are therefore inflated 40-65% and one sign flipped (w16e1_10k cosine: -1.89% at N=200, +2.81% at N=1000). All N=200 numbers are demoted to screen status. Conclusion: the mechanism is real and bounded -- it wins when the baseline FID is above ~22.5 and regresses below ~17; the production cell stays a significant regression. Honest R5c-family effect size at matched NFE is -9.37%, not -28.43% (smoke ckpt), not -25.39% (chunk-mean) and not -13.18% (N=200).

open_gaps.result: The pre-registered blend-on/blend-off contrast at NFE=150 was run (3 seeds, N=200, canonical HMMER counter). beta=0 is not a neutral control: with m = 1 - beta it sets m=1, so the restart carries the previous sample and injects NO fresh perturbation. That arm collapses on all three seeds -- 0/0/0 hits vs baseline 37/36/32, 95-99/200 unique sequences, median entropy 1.68 bits vs 3.68 baseline, top-3 residue fraction 0.98 vs 0.34 -- the same low-complexity attractor already documented for R1 in r1-d004-remeasure.md section 6. The prescribed rule ('CI excludes 0 positive -> the blend gets credit') therefore fires but its inference is not licensed: the contrast is perturbation-vs-none, not blend-vs-none. A non-degenerate endpoint was added on the same axis (beta=1.0: fresh per-record simplex, no memory; not in the pre-registration, no new seeds): it is healthy (200/200 unique, 4.13 bits) and TIES beta=1/6 in 3/3 seeds (delta -0.010/+0.055/+0.055 hits per record, every CI spans 0), while both sit above baseline (beta=1/6 clears the CI in 2/3 seeds, beta=1 in 1/3). Conclusion: R1's NFE=150 gain is carried by the per-record random restart perturbation, not by the memory blend -- the D-004b conclusion, now measured with the blend actually executing (GAP-25's arm C had the gate closed). Controls: baseline FASTA byte-identical across beta within each seed (3/3); seed42 beta=1/6 reproduces the GAP-41b prefix 200/200 byte-identical; the N=200 seed42 arm is a byte-identical prefix of the N=1000 run. The frozen R1 headline is unchanged.
